lead_cases: KKR Global Atlantic Accordia and Apollo Athene
plain_english_money_question: Whose insurance or retirement money is being routed into which named assets and what cash comes back to the legal entity
current_best_evidence: capital-flow-theme-package-with-exhibits-pass-1.md plus KKR Accordia and Apollo Athene statutory source passes
decisive_source_package: Statutory Schedule D or BA detail plus investment income plus proceeds/disposals plus liability cost spread plus legal entity waterfall
pass_test: Named CUSIP holdings income and proceeds reconcile to legal entity cash inflow and can be compared with liability funding cost
hold_or_fail_test: If Schedule D income and disposal fields do not tie to receipt or spread evidence then keep as statutory asset-income proxy only
why_this_is_next: This is the best route back to the original big-money players because it can get below platform AUM into legal entities assets income and proceeds

why_this_is_next: FPL is closest to receipt proof but the last mile needs billing and collection schedules that may be confidential or time-gated
